cases.name: Heidi Hamel Davis
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Heidi was a hard worker and currently worked as a Registered Nurse at North Oaks Hospital. Her true passion was in fitness, and she enjoyed teaching several fitness classes at Spoga in her free time. Heidi was a member of Trinity Baptist Church where she attended regularly with her family. She was truly one to light up a room and was known to be full of life. Heidi made friends with everyone and was genuinely a kind person. She adored her children and was most happy spending time with them. Heidi was a beautiful woman with an even more beautiful spirit. She left a huge impact on all who knew her and will be deeply missed."
cases.narrative: She was found lying outside of their home suffering from gunshot wounds.
